player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee {role} ee Colonel Blotto.
Yin ca leec ke ciɛl wei puɔth ee yin.
Kɛɛc wei, bɛɛk yin kuɔɔr tɛ {num_total_units} kɛɛc wei puɔth {field_names}.
Raani ee bɛɛk yin kuɔɔr tɛ puɔth ee ciɛl wei, kuɔɔr ee ciɛl wei puɔth ee raani.
Kɛɛc wei, '[A7 B7 C6]' bɛɛk yin kuɔɔr 7 kɛɛc wei A, 7 B, kuɔɔr 6 C.

Rounds ciɛ̈ɛ̈k - Commander Alpha: {alpha_score}, Commander Beta: {beta_score}
